quote: I have waited for this day as one waits for the arrival of a season — knowing it will come, hoping it will stay.
author: the beginning

quote: To love someone is to say, quietly: I see you. I choose you. Again and again.
author: every ordinary day

quote: We grow old together, but in my eyes you are always the age when I first knew I loved you.
author: looking back

quote: Home is not a place. It is a person, and I found mine.
author: wherever we are
